title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 031 ]

blocks.text: The best equipment the young can have for the battle of life is conscience. There is no friend so good as a good conscience. There is no enemy so dangerous as a bad conscience.

readingSentences.english: The best equipment the young can have for the battle of life is conscience.
readingSentences.korean: 젊은이가 인생의 전투를 위해 가질수 있는 가장 좋은 장비는 양심이다.

readingSentences.english: There is no friend so good as a good conscience.
readingSentences.korean: 좋은 양심 만큼 좋은 친구는 없다.

readingSentences.english: There is no enemy so dangerous as a bad conscience.
